method: sha256(id) mod 1000 < 300 -> dev, else test (CONTRACTS.md section 7). A stratum is rebalanced only if badly unbalanced (|z| > 2 against 0.30, or chi-square homogeneity p < 0.05 within its family); rebalancing assigns the round(0.3 n) items with the smallest sha256(id) mod 1000 to dev. No stratum met the criterion; no adjustment was made.
